label: source-bound transition prerequisites; conditional paths not target proof

requirements.condition: sets aot_only, use_interpreter, use_aot_trampolines; does not set force_use_interpreter
requirements.required_evidence: Confirm selected full-AOT/interpreter runtime configuration; do not substitute JIT or LLVM modes.

requirements.condition: static obj=NULL; params[0]=address of int32 cookie; nonnull exc catches/converts errors; return int is boxed
requirements.required_evidence: Attach calling thread; retain/handle managed objects across GC; check exc before unboxing.

requirements.condition: tries jit_only/AOT method; unavailable compiled method with interpreter enabled selects use_interp; :3208 invokes callback
requirements.required_evidence: For intended interpreted Probe verify use_interp rather than assume INTERP forces all invocations.

requirements.condition: builds runtime-invoke IL wrapper; obtains InterpMethod and executes frame
requirements.required_evidence: Enable method builder, IL transform, TLS stacks and core library; do not mistake IL generation for permission to emit native JIT code.

requirements.condition: nonnull exc branch emits managed Exception catch; stores exception via pointer
requirements.required_evidence: Exercise ThrowForHostBoundaryTest and missing-import exceptions; never unbox exception result.
Support metadata signature/marshaler wrapper creation for int32 and int32 byref; no strings/structs/delegates required by Probe imports.

requirements.condition: reads ImplMap/ModuleRef, optional dllmap, loads module, probes symbol and caches address
requirements.required_evidence: Admit exact Probe metadata and narrow resolver scope; retain code addresses until managed calls end.

requirements.condition: __Internal uses mono_dl_open(NULL); symbol lookup may mangle if NO_MANGLE absent
requirements.required_evidence: Actual process namespace lookup or explicit mapped bridge scope must be supplied; fallback callback alone proves no strict allowlist.

requirements.condition: non-dynamic simple signature when proper MonoContext available; I4 and pointers accepted; direct pointer-sized C calls through do_icall_wrapper
requirements.required_evidence: Verify generated native signature and actual platform calling ABI: AbiVersion V_P eligible; RuntimeProbe PP_P candidate. No emitted-code/trampoline claim from lexical trace.

requirements.condition: fallback uses AOT interp_to_native_trampoline; CallContext arch helpers or build_args_from_sig; special no-proper-context LMF wrapper branch
requirements.required_evidence: Only mandatory if fallback selected; supply named mscorlib AOT trampoline, ABI argument/return handling and correct unwind metadata.

requirements.condition: native wrapper enters/exits GC safe state except TARGET_WASM/skip branches; direct and fallback calls push LMF; context-less branch errors
requirements.required_evidence: Supply cooperative GC transitions, TLS/LMF stack, stack/register context capture and resume; do not infer target macros.

requirements.condition: AOT mode loads restore_context, call_filter, throw_exception, rethrow_exception, rethrow_preserve_exception; invokes mono_arch_exceptions_init
requirements.required_evidence: Provide real mscorlib AOT module and registered unwind/exception architecture implementation even if imports use fast calls.

requirements.condition: uses LMF and mono_handle_exception; restores native context if needed; resume state roots exception with GC handle
requirements.required_evidence: Supply actual interpreter-aware EH walking and context restore; corlib InvalidOperationException/string allocation remains necessary.

requirements.condition: compiled-call entry wrappers and function-pointer paths use these; public runtime-invoke interpreter callback itself is direct C
requirements.required_evidence: Probe declares no callbacks/delegates; do not require reverse function-pointer entry for selected Probe path without observed reachable dependency.
